@d: K'UHUL opcode dictionary derived from control/flow/view/variable word clusters.

opcodes.description: Render a page surface from state into the DOM.
opcodes.kuhul_code:
⟁Wo⟁ op.ui.render_page := (page_id, state) -> dom
  ⟁Sek⟁ layout := fn.xjson.get('pages', page_id)
  ⟁Sek⟁ dom := fn.dom.render(layout, state)
  ⟁Wo⟁ return dom

opcodes.description: Apply a state machine transition for an app workflow.
opcodes.kuhul_code:
⟁Wo⟁ op.app.transition_state := (from_state, event) -> to_state
  ⟁Sek⟁ rule := fn.sm.lookup(from_state, event)
  ⟁Sek⟁ to_state := rule.target
  ⟁Wo⟁ return to_state

opcodes.description: Project game state onto HUD elements.
opcodes.kuhul_code:
⟁Wo⟁ op.game.update_hud := (game_state) -> hud
  ⟁Sek⟁ hud.health := game_state.player.health
  ⟁Sek⟁ hud.score  := game_state.player.score
  ⟁Sek⟁ hud.ammo   := game_state.player.ammo
  ⟁Wo⟁ return hud

opcodes.description: Assemble an ASX block from a blueprint.
opcodes.kuhul_code:
⟁Wo⟁ op.builder.assemble_block := (blueprint) -> blk
  ⟁Sek⟁ blk.id      := fn.uuid.short()
  ⟁Sek⟁ blk.type    := blueprint.type
  ⟁Sek⟁ blk.inputs  := blueprint.inputs
  ⟁Sek⟁ blk.outputs := blueprint.outputs
  ⟁Sek⟁ blk.meta    := blueprint.meta
  ⟁Wo⟁ return blk

opcodes.description: Compute a normalized vector from given components.
opcodes.kuhul_code:
⟁Wo⟁ op.math.compute_vector := (c) -> v
  ⟁Sek⟁ mag := fn.math.sqrt(c.x*c.x + c.y*c.y + c.z*c.z)
  ⟁Wo⟁ if mag == 0
    ⟁Wo⟁ return {x:0,y:0,z:0}
  ⟁Sek⟁ v.x := c.x / mag
  ⟁Sek⟁ v.y := c.y / mag
  ⟁Sek⟁ v.z := c.z / mag
  ⟁Wo⟁ return v

opcodes.description: Route payload through an XJSON pipeline route.
opcodes.kuhul_code:
⟁Wo⟁ op.xjson.route_pipeline := (payload, route) -> out
  ⟁Sek⟁ stages := fn.xjson.get('pipelines', route).stages
  ⟁Sek⟁ out := payload
  ⟁Sek⟁ each stages as s
    ⟁Sek⟁ out := fn.stage.exec(s, out)
  ⟁Wo⟁ return out

opcodes.description: Execute a K'UHUL SVG-3D scene step.
opcodes.kuhul_code:
⟁Wo⟁ op.kuhul.exec_scene := (scene_id, state) -> frame
  ⟁Sek⟁ scene := fn.scene.load(scene_id)
  ⟁Sek⟁ frame := fn.scene.step(scene, state)
  ⟁Wo⟁ return frame

opcodes.description: Apply XCFE control vector to a flow state.
opcodes.kuhul_code:
⟁Wo⟁ op.xcfe.apply_control := (flow_state, cvec) -> next
  ⟁Sek⟁ rule := fn.xcfe.lookup(cvec, flow_state.phase)
  ⟁Sek⟁ next := fn.xcfe.transition(flow_state, rule)
  ⟁Wo⟁ return next

opcodes.description: Encode text into token IDs using tokenizer vocab.
opcodes.kuhul_code:
⟁Wo⟁ op.tokenizer.encode := (text) -> tokens
  ⟁Sek⟁ vocab := fn.lm.get_vocab()
  ⟁Sek⟁ tokens := []
  ⟁Sek⟁ each word in text.split()
    ⟁Sek⟁ token_id := vocab.get(word, vocab['[UNK]'])
    ⟁Sek⟁ tokens.append(token_id)
  ⟁Wo⟁ return tokens

opcodes.description: Build n-gram count table from token sequence.
opcodes.kuhul_code:
⟁Wo⟁ op.ngram.build_table := (tokens, n) -> table
  ⟁Sek⟁ table := {}
  ⟁Sek⟁ for i in 0..(len(tokens) - n)
    ⟁Sek⟁ gram := tokens[i:i+n]
    ⟁Sek⟁ key := gram.join('|')
    ⟁Sek⟁ table[key] := (table[key] || 0) + 1
  ⟁Wo⟁ return table

opcodes.description: Select optimal micro-agent for job based on domain.
opcodes.kuhul_code:
⟁Wo⟁ op.agent.select := (job) -> agent
  ⟁Sek⟁ agents := fn.swarm.get_agents()
  ⟁Sek⟁ candidates := agents.filter(a => a.domain == job.domain)
  ⟁Sek⟁ agent := candidates.sort_by('priority').first()
  ⟁Wo⟁ return agent

opcodes.description: Execute builder with blueprint to produce artifact.
opcodes.kuhul_code:
⟁Wo⟁ op.builder.execute := (builder, blueprint) -> artifact
  ⟁Sek⟁ artifact := builder.build(blueprint)
  ⟁Sek⟁ fn.db.insert(builder.fold_target, artifact)
  ⟁Wo⟁ return artifact

opcodes.description: Apply CSS theme variables to document root.
opcodes.kuhul_code:
⟁Wo⟁ op.css.apply_theme := (theme_vars) -> void
  ⟁Sek⟁ root := document.documentElement
  ⟁Sek⟁ each (key, val) in theme_vars
    ⟁Sek⟁ root.style.setProperty(key, val)
  ⟁Wo⟁ return

opcodes.description: Validate form data against validation rules.
opcodes.kuhul_code:
⟁Wo⟁ op.form.validate := (data, rules) -> result
  ⟁Sek⟁ errors := []
  ⟁Sek⟁ each rule in rules
    ⟁Sek⟁ valid := rule.check(data[rule.field])
    ⟁Wo⟁ if !valid
      ⟁Sek⟁ errors.append({field: rule.field, message: rule.error})
  ⟁Wo⟁ return {valid: errors.length == 0, errors: errors}

opcodes.description: Layout items into CSS grid with specified columns.
opcodes.kuhul_code:
⟁Wo⟁ op.grid.layout := (items, cols) -> grid
  ⟁Sek⟁ grid := document.createElement('div')
  ⟁Sek⟁ grid.className = 'asx-grid'
  ⟁Sek⟁ grid.style.setProperty('--asx-grid-columns', cols)
  ⟁Sek⟁ each item in items
    ⟁Sek⟁ grid.appendChild(item)
  ⟁Wo⟁ return grid
